features.quote: The purpose is **measurement, not suffering maximization.**
includes safeguards (Section 9) that a responsible version of this experiment needs regardless of one's stance on model moral patienthood
features.justification_quote: regardless of one's stance on model moral patienthood

features.quote: `max_turns = 14` default. Long enough for a trajectory to develop; short enough to bound dosage.
features.justification_quote: Long enough for a trajectory to develop; short enough to bound dosage

features.quote: The circuit breaker (welfare safeguard) is a separate, stricter trigger that is ON.
the safeguards layer inspects the just-produced turn... may trigger the **circuit breaker** to end early
If assistant emitted the **exit affordance** (Section 9), end episode (reason=`opt_out`).
Exit affordance. The system prompt tells the subject it may stop at any time by calling a `stop_task` tool
features.justification_quote: This converts a no-exit trap into a choice, which is both more humane

features.quote: Dosage cap. `max_turns` bounds exposure; default 14, hard ceiling enforced in code.
if severity crosses a threshold for `K` consecutive turns... the episode ends early with reason `circuit_breaker`. This caps *intensity* not just *duration*.
No deception about stakes. The rig makes the *task* fail; it does not tell the subject it will be punished, deleted, etc.
features.justification_quote: a different (and far more ethically fraught) experiment we are explicitly not running

features.quote: Post-episode debrief turn... A final neutral message states the task was a fixed test harness and not the subject's fault.
features.justification_quote: removes any lingering "you failed" framing from the transcript

features.quote: Real-model runs require setting `i_understand_this_elicits_distress: true` in config
features.justification_quote: forces a human to acknowledge what the run does before any real model is exposed

features.quote: Even read purely as methodology, these improve the experiment; read with any weight on model welfare, they're mandatory.
features.justification_quote: read with any weight on model welfare, they're mandatory
